name: Pasta
message: 「You told him to do whatever he wants, nya!?」

name: Azel
message: 「For that reason, I have nothing to do with irrational emotions such as love.」

name: Azel
message: 「I am not like the rest of you. I am an envoy of God.」

name: Pasta
message: 「Your voice is loud, nya. Why are you getting so worked up, nya?」

name: Azel
message: 「...I am not getting worked up. I am calm. That is precisely why I was able to respond appropriately.」

name: Pasta
message: 「And that response was 'do whatever you want,' nya?」

name: Azel
message: 「Indeed. Whoever Synn is liked by has nothing to do with me.」

name: Pasta
message: 「So you're fine with him getting together with that Nanaka girl, nya?」

name: Azel
message: 「He may do as he pleases. Everyone will perish soon enough anyway.」

name: Pasta
message: 「Not only are you an idiot, you're a coward too, nya.」

name: Azel
message: 「What did you say! How am I a coward?」

name: Azel
message: 「I am not running from my mission. My heart remains entirely with the Lord's will.」

name: Azel
message: 「This was the Lord testing my heart. It must be.」

name: Azel
message: 「Anything trivial enough to go unnoticed is of no consequence.」

name: Pasta
message: 「The old you would never have talked about things like this with Pasta, nya.」

name: Soltia
message: 「Once Re-Crea begins, it will activate on its own」

name: Pasta
message: 「That's rare, nya. That's the first time I've seen you yawn, nya」

name: Soltia
message: 「Lately, the class I'm in charge of decided to participate in the Holy Night Festival, you see. There's paperwork, consultations, and all sorts of things to deal with」

name: Pasta
message: 「I want you to take my picture, nya」

name: Pasta
message: 「What you would call a whim, nya」

name: Azel
message: 「Probably... no, I won't know until I get it developed」

name: Azel
message: 「I'll give it to you when it's ready」

name: Azel
message: 「It's already late today. I'll drop it off at the photo shop tomorrow... so the day after tomorrow」

name: Pasta
message: 「Like I said, it's just on a whim, nya」
